answer: A harbor under a ridge sends one cargo boat per agent on a 40-day voyage along the mesa coast, and each boat carries a copper plate stamped at every port it reaches. The agent pays the crew's wage, hands the manifest to the harbor clerk at each stamp, and a plate that comes back short a stamp voids the cargo and the agent's berth for a season. A thousand fake names need a thousand crewed boats, a thousand 40-day voyages, and a thousand copper plates stamped in six ports no clerk will backdate.
